description: This file contains extension methods for configuring and enhancing the Orleans silo hosting, including clustering setup, activity propagation, and distributed grain directory registration.

methods.name: AddActivityPropagation
methods.description: Adds activity propagation filters for grain calls to enable tracing and diagnostics.

methods.name: UseLocalhostClustering
methods.description: Configures the silo to run in development mode with localhost clustering for testing.

methods.name: UseDevelopmentClustering (overload with IPEndPoint)
methods.description: Sets up development-only clustering with a specified primary silo endpoint.

methods.name: UseDevelopmentClustering (with configureOptions action)
methods.description: Configures development clustering with custom options.

methods.name: UseDevelopmentClustering (with OptionsBuilder)
methods.description: Sets up development clustering with options configured via an options builder.

methods.name: ConfigurePrimarySiloEndpoint
methods.description: Internal helper to set the primary silo endpoint in clustering options.

methods.name: AddDistributedGrainDirectory
methods.description: Registers and enables the distributed grain directory feature within the silo services.
